thread:
lina: FYI — canary failures in eu-west1 started ~10:20 UTC after the NCCL+driver push. Hanging multi-GPU inference on racks that mix H100s and A100s.
ops-bot: [alert] 4 canaries failed in eu-west1 (inference-path). Investigate.
raj: ugh. which versions were pushed?
lina: NCCL 3.5.1, CUDA driver 535.86.10, kernel 6.5.9. Rollout targeted mixed-arch pools to improve util but looks like a compatibility corner.
mike: any logs/snippets?
lina: saw repeated timeouts: `NCCL WARN Call to allreduce timed out after 120000ms` and the processes stay at 100% GPU spin. pasted minimal log: ```
[0] NCCL WARN Call to allreduce timed out after 120000ms, rank 0->1
[0] nccl: INFO Finalizing
```
hana: is this only on mixed racks? pure-H100 or pure-A100 unaffected?
lina: pure racks look fine in canaries. mixed racks 3/4 failing.
julia: can you paste `nvidia-smi topo -m` for a failing host?
lina: sure: ```
Host: rack-12-node-3
GPU0 GPU1 GPU2 GPU3
GPU0  X   NV2  PCIe NV2
GPU1 NV2   X  NV1  PCIe
GPU2 PCIe NV1  X   NV2
GPU3 NV2  PCIe NV2  X
```
mike: NVLink meshes look asymmetric between A100/H100 pairs — firmware mismatch maybe. Any firmware updates landed?
lina: firmware 22.5 on H100s, 21.9 on A100s (we didn't force firmware sync during rolling).
raj: that could explain a p2p handshake regression. recall NCCL 3.5 tightened p2p assumptions.
hana: quick workaround: try forcing P2P off between mismatch with `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` or set `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS`. Might reduce perf but should avoid hangs.
julia: can we repro locally? I can spin mixed vms and run nightly allreduce test. what's the minimal command?
lina: `python tests/allreduce_bench.py --gpus 4 --iters 200 --backend nccl` — reproduces in ~1 minute on failing hosts.
mike: ok I'll run a canary rollback of NCCL to 3.4.8 on the eu-west canaries and add the env `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` as a temporary mitigation for mixed racks.
deploy-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/ops/rollbacks/pull/432 — rollback nccl->3.4.8 on canaries (review required).
raj: also escalate to firmware/board team: mismatch between H100/A100 firmware needs audit. @hana can you run fleet query to list mixed racks + firmware versions?
hana: on it. running `fleetctl query --tag rack:mixed --fields gpu_fw,kernel` and will post results in ~15m.
ops-bot: Note: if we disable P2P we expect 20-40% drop in throughput on mixed racks. Might impact SLO.
julia: can you add perf tests to the canary pipeline to catch this regression earlier? I can add an asymmetric-topology test that exercises P2P.
lina: yes please — add a small targeted test that runs before merging nccl/driver bumps.
mike: rollback scheduled in 10m for canaries; if green we'll expand rollback to a subset of serving nodes. If rollback fails we'll put a short capacity redirect to dedicated us-west pool.
raj: action items: mike -> rollback canaries + monitor (30m), hana -> fleet firmware report (2h), julia -> add asymmetric topo canary test (tomorrow), lina -> run manual repro + collect dmesg/kern logs (now).
lina: quick note on logs I'll paste: ```
[    5.123456] nvidia-gpu: ecc error? no
[    5.123789] kernel: BUG: CPU#1 stuck for 23s
[    5.124000] nvlink: link error: link 3 reported fatal error
```
mike: thanks. if nvlink reports fatal errors that's a hardware/firmware handshake problem, so we need firmware sync.
hana: fleet query results: 18 racks flagged as mixed; 12 have mismatched firmware versions, 3 with older kernel (6.1.x). Posting table to #eng-infra-private.
julia: I'll submit a canary pipeline PR today to run mixed-topology allreduce on a small set of canaries before any driver/nccl bump.
raj: good. long-term we should gate nccl driver upgrades by mixed-topology smoke tests or auto-disable p2p for heterogeneous racks.
lina: agreed. for now rolling back canaries and setting `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` for mixed pools.
mike: executing rollback now — will post results in ~15m. :hammer_and_wrench:
ops-bot: [info] rollback job started (job id: rb-202310).
canary-bot: [canary] canary nccl-3.4.8 booted on eu-west1-canary-07 — health checks running.
lina: thanks all. keep updates here. :eyes:
